description: This file implements the main page component 'AllReasonersPage' for browsing, filtering, and monitoring reasoners in a web interface. It manages API data fetching, real-time SSE event handling, filter state, and renders UI elements such as reasoner grid/table, filters, stats, and alerts.

methods.name: fetchReasoners
methods.description: Fetches the list of reasoners from API with specified filters, handling success, loading, and error states.

methods.name: handleFiltersChange
methods.description: Updates filters state and triggers data fetch.

methods.name: handleReasonerClick
methods.description: Handles user clicking on a reasoner to navigate to its detail page.

methods.name: handleRefresh
methods.description: Refetches the reasoners data with current filters.

methods.name: handleShowAll
methods.description: Sets filters to show all reasoners regardless of status.

methods.name: getEmptyStateType
methods.description: Determines the appropriate empty state based on data and filters.
